headers.//: Unhashed public/ assets inherit the HTML cache policy (max-age=0, must-revalidate), so the share card was re-fetched from origin on every preview render. Its filename is stable and its content changes only when someone replaces the file, in which case the og:image URL should change too.

Keep the preview hostnames out of the index. Every *.vercel.app alias serves the complete site with a canonical pointing at the apex, but canonical is a hint and Google discounts it from a host whose content visibly differs — nostr-beginner-guide.vercel.app still serves /simulators/ at 200 while the apex 308s it to sandstr.app. Removing the aliases in the Vercel dashboard is the real fix; this is the belt-and-braces half that lives in the repo.
